fields.description: Gateway the address is configured on.
fields.label: Gateway

fields.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 that outbound connections use. It must already be configured on the gateway's network interface; the gateway's own address is allowed.
fields.label: IP Address

fields.description: Assigned on save: the pool name, a dash and a number under the cluster's default domain, e.g. p1-1.blr.frappemail.com. The gateway announces it when sending from this address; it gets an A record pointing at the address, and the address's reverse DNS must point back at it.
fields.label: EHLO Hostname

fields.description: Reverse DNS of the address points at the EHLO hostname. Checked daily; receivers reject mail from addresses without it.
fields.label: PTR Verified
